item.text: [{"task_id":"84ba50d3","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    fg = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    wall = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    step = int(round(params['motion'][0]))","    wide = int(round(params['motion'][1]))","    gap = int(round(params['motion'][2]))","    height, width = grid.shape","    barriers = [r for r in range(height) if np.all(grid[r] == wall)]","    if len(barriers) != 1 or bg == fg or step <= 0 or wide <= 1:","        return grid.copy()","    barrier = barriers[0]","    out = grid.copy()","    out[grid == fg] = bg","    remaining = set((int(p[0]), int(p[1])) for p in np.argwhere(grid == fg))","    directions = [(int(round(params['neighbors'][i][0])), int(round(params['neighbors'][i][1]))) for i in range(len(params['neighbors']))]","    while remaining:","        seed = remaining.pop()","        component = [seed]","        queue = [seed]","        while queue:","            r, c = queue.pop()","            for dr, dc in directions:","                neighbor = (r + dr, c + dc)","                if neighbor in remaining:","                    remaining.remove(neighbor)","                    component.append(neighbor)","                    queue.append(neighbor)","        counts = {}","        for r, c in component:","            counts[r] = counts.get(r, 0) + 1","        broad_rows = [r for r in counts if counts[r] >= wide]","        if broad_rows:","            shift = barrier - gap - max(broad_rows)","        else:","            shift = height - gap - max(r for r, c in component)","        shift = max(0, shift)","        shift = (shift // step) * step","        for r, c in component:","            if r < barrier and r + shift >= barrier:","                out[barrier, c] = bg","        for r, c in component:","            target = r + shift","            if 0 <= target < height:","                out[target, c] = fg","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"motion":[3],"neighbors":[4,2]},"params":{"colors":[8,1,2],"motion":[1,2,1],"neighbors":[[-1,0],[1,0],[0,-1],[0,1]]},"rationale":"Blue connected objects fall downward. Their lowest row containing multiple pixels rests immediately above the red barrier; narrower portions can penetrate it. Objects with only single-pixel rows fall to the bottom. Pixels crossing the barrier punch holes, and each object's shape is preserved."}]
